title: Ziyarat Aimmat al-Muminin
intro: A comprehensive visitation for the Imams, including the source edition’s entrance recitations and supplication after the ziyarat.
description: Read Ziyarat Aimmat al-Muminin with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
This form of ziyarah can be said during visiting all the Holy Imams in all months and days.
In his book of Misbah al-Za'ir, Sayyid Ibn Tawus has reported this form of ziyarah from the Holy Imams (peace be upon them)
Recite this when you do Ghusl for performing the ziyarah,

blocks.english: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
in the way of Allah (I proceed),
and on the creed of the Messenger of Allah.
O Allah, (please do) cleanse me from the filth of sins
and the dirt of defects,
purify me with the water of repentance,
dress me the garb of protection (against sinning),

blocks.arabic: وَأَيِّدْنِي بِلُطْفٍ مِنْكَ يُوَفِّقُنِي لِصَالِحِ ٱلأَعْمَالِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ayyidni bilutfin minka yuwaffiquni lisalihi al-a`mali
blocks.english: and aid me with Your compassion on account of which You may lead me to (doing) righteous deeds.
You are verily the Lord of great favor.

blocks.text: When you approach the gate of the shrine, you may say the following words:

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّقَنِي لِقَصْدِ وَلِيِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi waffaqani liqasdi waliyyihi
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah Who has led me to come to His intimate servant
and to visit His argument-person (against creatures)
and has allowed me to enter the precinct of him (i.e. His intimate servant);

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ يَبْخَسْنِي حَظِّي مِنْ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam yabkhasni hazzi min ziyarati qabrihi
blocks.english: thus, He has not deprived me of the opportunity to visit the tomb of him
and to stay at the patio of his shrine
and at the courtyard of his grave.

blocks.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَسِمْنِي بِحِرْمَانِ مَا أَمَّلْتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yasimni bihirmani ma ammaltuhu
blocks.english: All praise be to Allah Who has not decided for me the deprivation of that which I hope,
has not prevented me against that for which I have longed

blocks.transliteration: wa la qata`a raja'i fima tawaqqa`tuhu
blocks.english: and has not disappointed me as regards that which I have anticipated;
rather, He has dressed me good health from Him,
bestowed upon me with His grace,
and granted me His honoring.

blocks.text: If you enter the shrine, you may stop at the pure tomb and say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O the Imams of the believers,
the chiefs of the pious,
the heads of the truthful,
the princes of the righteous,
the leaders of the good-doers,
the epitomes of the truly guided ones,
the light for the cognizant,
the inheritors of the Prophets,
the choicest of the Prophet’s successors,
the sunlight of the devout ones,
the full moons of the vicegerents (of the Prophets),
the (true) servants of the All-beneficent,
the partners of the Qur’an,
the course to the (true) faith,
the essences of the realities,
and the interceders for the beings.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
I bear witness that You are the doors to Allah,
the clues to (attaining) His mercy,
the keys to His forgiveness,
the clouds of His pleasure,
the lanterns of the gardens of His Paradise,
the carriers of His distinguishing Book,
the hoarders of His knowledge,
the keepers of His secret,
and the place of the descent of His revelation.
The trusts of prophethood are possessed by you.
So are the charges of the Divine Message.
You are Allah’s trustees, well-beloved,
servants, and choicest ones.
You are also the supporter of (the creed of) His Oneness,
the pillars of glorifying Him,
the callers to (the belief in) His Books,
the guardians over His beings,
and the custodians of His trusts.

blocks.arabic: لاَ يَسْبِقُكُمْ ثَنَاءُ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ فِي ٱلإِخْلاَصِ وَٱلْخُشُوعِ
blocks.transliteration: la yasbiqukum thana'u almala'ikati fi al-ikhlasi walkhushu`i
blocks.english: Neither the praising of the angels with all of its sincerity and reverence can precede Yours

blocks.transliteration: wa la yudaddukum dhu ibtihalin wa khudu`in
blocks.english: nor can any earnest suppliant and pious one compare himself to Yours.

blocks.arabic: أَنَّىٰ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِي تَوَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ رِيَاضَتَهَا بِٱلْخَوْفِ وَٱلرَّجَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: anna wa lakumu alqulubu allati tawalla allahu riyadataha bilkhawfi walrraja'i
blocks.english: How can that be! While your hearts are these which Allah Himself has schooled with means of fear and hope for Him,
made containers of thanksgiving and praising Him,
secured against even accidental inattentiveness,

blocks.transliteration: wa saffaha min su'i shawaghili alfatrati
blocks.english: and purified from the evil of languor.
More exactly, the inhabitants of the heaves seek nearness [to Allah] through their love for you
and disavowal of your enemies,
and through persistent weeping for your misfortunes
and imploring for Allah’s forgiveness for your adherents and supporters.
I, hereby, ask Allah, my Creator, to witness for me,
and I ask His angels and Prophets to witness for me, too
and I ask you, too, O my masters, to witness for me
that I have full faith in your (divinely commissioned) leadership,
I fully believe in your Imamate,
I confess of your successorship (to prophethood),
I am aware of your unmatched rank,
I am certain of your infallibility,
I submit to your leadership,
I seek nearness to Allah through my love for you
and disavowal of your enemies,

blocks.arabic: عَالِمٌ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ طَهَّرَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْفَوَاحِشِ
blocks.transliteration: `alimun bi'anna allaha qad tahharakum min alfawahishi
blocks.english: I know for sure that Allah has purified you from indecencies,

blocks.transliteration: ma zahara minha wa ma batana
blocks.english: whether open or secret,

blocks.transliteration: wa min kulli ribatin wa najasatin
blocks.english: and from all suspicions, filth,
all ill deeds, and ignominy.

blocks.arabic: وَمَنَحَكُمْ رَايَةَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّتِي مَنْ تَقَدَّمَهَا ضَلَّ
blocks.transliteration: wa manahakum rayata alhaqqi allati man taqaddamaha dalla
blocks.english: And He has granted you the pennon of the truth that whoever foregoes shall have missed the right way
and whoever lags behind shall have slipped.

blocks.arabic: وَفَرَضَ طَاعَتَكُمْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَسْوَدٍ وَأَبْيَضٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa farada ta`atakum `ala kulli aswadin wa abyadin
blocks.english: He has imposed the obedience to you upon all beings, be them black or white.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكُمْ قَدْ وَفَيْتُمْ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَذِمَّتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu annakum qad wafaytum bi`ahdi allahi wa dhimmatihi
blocks.english: I also bear witness that you have verily fulfilled your pledge and promise to Allah

blocks.arabic: وَبِكُلِّ مَا ٱشْتَرَطَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي كِتَابِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa bikulli ma ishtarata `alaykum fi kitabihi
blocks.english: and carried out all that which He stipulated on you in His Book.
You also called for (following) His Path,
exerted all your efforts in seeking His pleasure,

blocks.arabic: وَحَمَلْتُمُ ٱلْخَلاَئِقَ عَلَىٰ مِنْهَاجِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ وَمَسَالِكِ ٱلرِّسَالَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa hamaltum alkhalaiqa `ala minhaji alnnubuwwati wa masaliki alrrisalati
blocks.english: led the beings to the course of Prophethood and the paths of the Divine Message,
and dealt with them according to the norm of the Prophets
and the customs of the Prophets’ successors.
Nonetheless, none of your instructions was carried out,
and none lent you any ear.
So, Allah’s blessings be upon your souls and your bodies.

blocks.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: bi'abi anta wa ummi ya hujjata allahi
blocks.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O Argument of Allah.
You were certainly fed by the breast of faith,
weaned on the illumination of Islam,
nourished on the utter certitude,
dressed the garments of infallibility,
chosen and inherited the knowledge of the Book,
and prompted the decisive speech.

blocks.arabic: وَأُوضِحَ بِمَكَانِكَ مَعَارِفُ ٱلتَّنْزِيلِ وَغَوَامِضُ ٱلتَّأْوِيلِ
blocks.transliteration: wa udiha bimakanika ma`arifu alttanzili wa ghawamidu altta'wili
blocks.english: Through your position were the knowledge of the Divine Revelation and the mysteries of the interpretation (of the Qur’an) made clear.
To you was the pennon of the truth delivered.
You were charged with guiding the beings.
To you was the pledge of Imamate given exclusively.
You were assigned to preserve the religious law.

blocks.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ أَنَّكَ وَفَيْتَ بِشَرَائِطِ ٱلْوَصِيَّةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu ya mawlaya annaka wafayta bishara'iti alwasiyyati
blocks.english: I also bear witness, O my master, that you met all the qualifications of successorship,

blocks.arabic: وَقَضَيْتَ مَا لَزِمَكَ مِنْ حَدِّ ٱلطَّاعَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa qadayta ma lazimaka min haddi altta`ati
blocks.english: settled all your obligations as regards the obedience (to Allah),
carried successfully all the burdens of Imamate,

blocks.arabic: وَٱحْتَذَيْتَ مِثَالَ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ فِي ٱلصَّبْرِ وَالِٱجْتِهَادِ
blocks.transliteration: wahtadhayta mithala alnnubuwwati fi alssabri walijtihadi
blocks.english: and followed the example of prophethood in endurance, exertion of all possible efforts,
giving advice to the servants,
suppressing your rage, and pardoning the people.
You were also determined to act fairly with the creatures
and to be just in all issues.

blocks.arabic: وَوَكَّدْتَ ٱلْحُجَجَ عَلَىٰ ٱلأُمَّةِ بِٱلدَّلاَئِلِ ٱلصَّادِقَةِ وَٱلشَّرِيعَةِ ٱلنَّاطِقَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa wakkadta alhujaja `ala al-ummati bilddala'ili alssadiqati walshshari`ati alnnatiqati
blocks.english: You confirmed all the claims (of Allah) on the community through irrefutable proofs and through the speaking law

blocks.arabic: وَدَعَوْتَ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ ٱلْبَالِغَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa da`awta ila allahi bilhikmati albalighati walmaw`izati alhasanati
blocks.english: and called to the way of Allah with wisdom and fair exhortation.

blocks.arabic: فَمَنَعْتَ مِنْ تَقْوِيمِ ٱلزَّيْغِ وَسَدِّ ٱلثُّلَمِ
blocks.transliteration: famana`ta min taqwimi alzzayghi wa saddi alththulami
blocks.english: You thus stood against any rise of doubt and worked on rectifying all furrows,

blocks.transliteration: wa islahi alfasidi wa kasri almu`anidi
blocks.english: mending the wrong, beating the stubborn evildoer,

blocks.transliteration: wa ihya'i alssunani wa imatati albida`i
blocks.english: reviving the norms (of the Prophets), and annihilating the heresies

blocks.transliteration: hatta faraqta alddunya wa anta shahidun
blocks.english: until you departed this life as martyr

blocks.arabic: وَلَقِيتَ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَأَنْتَ حَمِيدٌ
blocks.transliteration: wa laqita rasula allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa anta hamidun
blocks.english: and met the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his Household, as praiseworthy.
May the blessings of Allah continue on you incessantly and increasingly.

blocks.text: You may then move to the side of the feet and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: يَا سَادَتِي يَا آلَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: ya sadati ya ala rasuli allahi
blocks.english: O my masters! O Household of Allah’s Messenger!

blocks.arabic: إِنِّي بِكُمْ أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ جَلَّ وَعَلاَ
blocks.transliteration: inni bikum ataqarrabu ila allahi jalla wa `ala
blocks.english: In your names do I seek nearness to Allah the All-majestic and All-elevated

blocks.arabic: بِٱلْخِلاَفِ عَلَىٰ ٱلَّذِينَ غَدَرُوٱ بِكُمْ وَنَكَثُوٱ بَيْعَتَكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: bilkhilafi `ala alladhina ghadaru bikum wa nakathu bay`atakum
blocks.english: by dissenting from those who betrayed you, breached their allegiance to you,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadu wilayatakum wa ankaru manzilatakum
blocks.english: denied your leadership, renounced your position,

blocks.arabic: وَخَلَعُوٱ رِبْقَةَ طَاعَتِكُمْ وَهَجَرُوٱ أَسْبَابَ مَوَدَّتِكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa khala`u ribqata ta`atikum wa hajaru asbaba mawaddatikum
blocks.english: gave up their obedience to you, abandoned the love for you,

blocks.arabic: وَتَقَرَّبُوٱ إِلَىٰ فَرَاعِنَتِهِمْ بِٱلْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْكُمْ وَٱلإِعْرَاضِ عَنْكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa taqarrabu ila fara`inatihim bilbara'ati minkum wal-i`radi `ankum
blocks.english: curried favor with their tyrant rulers through disavowing and rejecting you,

blocks.arabic: وَمَنَعُوكُمْ مِنْ إِقَامَةِ ٱلْحُدُودِ وَٱسْتِيصَالِ ٱلْجُحُودِ
blocks.transliteration: wa mana`ukum min iqamati alhududi wastisali aljuhudi
blocks.english: prevented you from carrying out the religious laws, eradicating atheism,

blocks.transliteration: wa sha`bi alssad`i wa lammi alshsha`athi
blocks.english: setting right the split, rejoining the scattered,

blocks.transliteration: wa saddi alkhalali wa tathqifi al-awadi
blocks.english: meeting the deficiency, straightening the crookedness,

blocks.arabic: وَإِمْضَاءِ ٱلأَحْكَامِ وَتَهْذِيبِ ٱلإِسْلاَمِ وَقَمْعِ ٱلآثَامِ
blocks.transliteration: wa imda'i al-ahkami wa tahdhibi al-islami wa qam`i al-athami
blocks.english: executing the divine laws, refining Islam, and restraining sins;
they stirred up the dust of wars and seditions against you,
unsheathed the swords of malice against you,
rent your coverings,
bought wines with the khumus levy that is decided for you exclusively,

blocks.arabic: وَصَرَفُوٱ صَدَقَاتِ ٱلْمَسَاكِينِ إِلَىٰ ٱلْمُضْحِكِينَ وَٱلسَّاخِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa sarafu sadaqati almasakini ila almudhikina walssakhirina
blocks.english: and paid the alms that are decided for the poor to the clowns and jokers.

blocks.arabic: وَذٰلِكَ بِمَا طَرَّقَتْ لَهُمُ ٱلْفَسَقَةُ ٱلْغُوَاةُ وَٱلْحَسَدَةُ ٱلْبُغَاةُ
blocks.transliteration: wa dhalika bima tarraqat lahumu alfasaqatu alghuwatu walhasadatu albughatu
blocks.english: All that was because of the urging practices of the licentious, the aberrant, the envious, and the oppressors;
the people of breach, treachery, rebellion, and deceit;
whose hearts are evil-smelling due to the filth of polytheism,
and whose bodies are suffocated with the dirt of atheism.

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ أَضَبُّوٱ عَلَىٰ ٱلنِّفَاقِ وَأَكَبُّوٱ عَلَىٰ عَلاَئِقِ ٱلشِّقَاقِ
blocks.transliteration: alladhina adabbu `ala alnnifaqi wa akabbu `ala `ala'iqi alshshiqaq
blocks.english: It is they who embraced hypocrisy and buckled down to dissension.

blocks.arabic: فَلَمَّا مَضَىٰ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱخْتَطَفُوٱ ٱلْغِرَّةَ وَٱنْتَهَزُوٱ ٱلْفُرْصَةَ وَٱنْتَهَكُوٱ ٱلْحُرْمَةَ
blocks.transliteration: falamma mada almustafa salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi ikhtatafu alghirrata wa intahazu alfursata wa intahaku alhurmata
blocks.english: So, when the Chosen Prophet, Allah’s peace be upon him and his Household, passed away, they seized the opportunity, took the occasion, and violated the sanctity.
They left him bed-ridden

blocks.arabic: وَأَسْرَعُوٱ لِنَقْضِ ٱلْبَيْعَةِ وَمُخَالَفَةِ ٱلْمَوَاثِيقِ ٱلْمُؤَكَّدَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa asra`u linaqdi albay`ati wa mukhalafati almawathiqi almu'akkadati
blocks.english: and hurried to preach their allegiance, break the covenants that had been confirmedly taken from them,

blocks.arabic: وَخِيَانَةِ ٱلأَمَانَةِ ٱلْمَعْرُوضَةِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْجِبَالِ ٱلرَّاسِيَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa khiyanati al-amanati alma`rudati `ala aljibali alrrasiyati
blocks.english: betray the Trust that had been offered to the unshakable mountains

blocks.arabic: وَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَحْمِلَهَا وَحَمَلَهَا ٱلإِنْسَانُ ٱلظَّلُومُ ٱلْجَهُولُ
blocks.transliteration: wa abat an tahmilaha wa hamalaha al-insanu alzzalumu aljahulu
blocks.english: but they (i.e. the mountains) refused to undergo; rather, man, the wronging and ignorant, accepted to assume it.
Man is actually dissenting, obstinate to committing grave sins,
and disdaining from submission to that whose end result is praiseworthy.

blocks.arabic: فَحُشِرَ سِفْلَةُ ٱلأَعْرَابِ وَبَقَايَا ٱلأَحْزَابِ إِلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلنُّبُوَّةِ وَٱلرِّسَالَةِ
blocks.transliteration: fahushira siflatu al-a`rabi wa baqaya al-ahzabi ila dari alnnubuwwati walrrisalati
blocks.english: Hence, the lowly Bedouins and the rest of the parties (who had allied each other against the Holy Prophet) were gathered to the abode of the prophethood, Divine Message,
Divine Revelation and angels,
the center of the authority of the (divinely commissioned) leadership (of the Holy Imams),
and the core of the Prophet’s successorship, inheritance, and Imamate.

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ نَقَضُوٱ عَهْدَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ فِي أَخِيهِ عَلَمِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: hatta naqadu `ahda almustafa fi akhihi `alami alhuda
blocks.english: They therefore preached the covenant (that they had made) to the Chosen Prophet as regards the leadership of his brother, the sign of true guidance (namely, Imam `Ali)

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْمُبَيِّنِ طَرِيقَ ٱلنَّجَاةِ مِنْ طُرُقِ ٱلرَّدَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: walmubayyini tariqa alnnajati min turuqi alrrada
blocks.english: who alone can distinguish the path of salvation from these of perdition,

blocks.arabic: وَجَرَحُوٱ كَبِدَ خَيْرِ ٱلْوَرَىٰ فِي ظُلْمِ ٱبْنَتِهِ وَٱضْطِهَادِ حَبِيبَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa jarahu kabida khayri alwara fi zulmi ibnatihi wa idtihadi habibatihi
blocks.english: and they injured the heart of the best of beings (namely, the Holy Prophet) when they oppressed and wronged his daughter; the much-loved one to him,

blocks.arabic: وَٱهْتِضَامِ عَزِيزَتِهِ بَضْعَةِ لَحْمِهِ وَفِلْذَةِ كَبِدِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ihtidami `azizatihi bad`ati lahmihi wa fildhati kabidihi
blocks.english: aggrieved his dearest one; the part of his flesh and the piece of his heart,

blocks.transliteration: wa khadhalu ba`laha wa saghgharu qadrahu
blocks.english: disappointed her husband, belittled him,

blocks.transliteration: wa istahallu maharimahu wa qata`u rahimahu
blocks.english: violated his sanctities, ruptured relations of kinship with him,

blocks.transliteration: wa ankaru ukhuwwatahu wa hajaru mawaddatahu
blocks.english: denied his fraternity (with the Holy Prophet), neglected his love for him,
defied their (obligatory) obedience to him, denied his leadership (over them),
gave even the slaves the opportunity to seize his position of leadership,

blocks.arabic: وَقَادُوهُ إِلَىٰ بَيْعَتِهِمْ مُصْلِتَةً سُيُوفَهَا مُقْذِعَةً أَسِنَّتَهَا
blocks.transliteration: wa qaduhu ila bay`atihim muslitatan suyufaha muqdhi`atan asinnataha
blocks.english: and led him to swear allegiance to them under unsheathed swords and directed spears

blocks.transliteration: wa huwa sakhitu alqalbi ha'iju alghadabi
blocks.english: while he was extremely irritated and enormously wrathful,
but very patient and self-possessed.

blocks.arabic: يَدْعُونَهُ إِلَىٰ بَيْعَتِهِمُ ٱلَّتِي عَمَّ شُومُهَا ٱلإِسْلاَمَ
blocks.transliteration: yad`unahu ila bay`atihim allati `amma shumuha al-islama
blocks.english: They were asking him to swear allegiance to their rulership whose misfortune prevailed in Islam absolutely

blocks.transliteration: wa zara`at fi qulubi ahliha al-athama
blocks.english: and planted sins in the hearts of the Muslims.
They therefore acted insubordinately towards Salman, banished al-Miqdad,

blocks.transliteration: wa nafat jundubaha wa fataqat batna `ammariha
blocks.english: exiled Jundub, tore the abdomen of `Ammar,

blocks.arabic: وَحَرَّفَتِ ٱلْقُرْآنَ وَبَدَّلَتِ ٱلأَحْكَامَ وَغَيَّرَتِ ٱلْمَقَامَ
blocks.transliteration: wa harrafat alqur'ana wa baddalat al-ahkama wa ghayyarat almaqama
blocks.english: distorted the (true interpretation of the) Qur’an, misrepresented the religious laws, changed the place of al-maqam,
gave free hand to the Released Ones to dispose of the khumus tax,

blocks.arabic: وَسَلَّطَتْ أَوْلاَدَ ٱللُّعَنَاءِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْفُرُوجِ وَٱلدِّمَاءِ
blocks.transliteration: wa sallatat awlada allu`ana'i `ala alfuruji walddima'i
blocks.english: set up the descendants of the accursed ones as absolute rulers over the honors and blood (of Muslims),
intermixed the lawful with the unlawful,
belittled faith and Islam,

blocks.arabic: وَهَدَمَتِ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ وَأَغَارَتْ عَلَىٰ دَارِ ٱلْهِجْرَةِ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَرَّةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa hadamat alka`bata wa agharat `ala dari alhijrati yawma alharrati
blocks.english: demolished the (Holy) Ka`bah, raided the abode of the (Holy Prophet’s) immigration on the day of al-Harrah Raid,

blocks.arabic: وَأَبْرَزَتْ بَنَاتِ ٱلْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَٱلأَنْصَارِ لِلنَّكَالِ وَٱلسَّوْرَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa abrazat banati almuhajirina wal-ansari lilnnakali walssawrati
blocks.english: subjected the daughters of the Emigrants and the Supporters to punishment and humiliation,
caused them to dress the garments of disgrace and scandal,

blocks.arabic: وَرَخَّصَتْ لأَهْلِ ٱلشُّبْهَةِ فِي قَتْلِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ ٱلصَّفْوَةِ
blocks.transliteration: wa rakhkhasat li'ahli alshshubhati fi qatli ahli bayti alssafwati
blocks.english: and allowed the suspicious people to massacre the choice Household (of the Holy Prophet),

blocks.transliteration: wa ibadati naslihi wa istisali sha'fatihi
blocks.english: to eradicate his (i.e. the Holy Prophet) offspring, to eliminate his progeny,

blocks.transliteration: wa sabyi haramihi wa qatli ansarihi
blocks.english: to capture his harem, to kill his supporters,

blocks.transliteration: wa kasri minbarihi wa qalbi mafkharihi
blocks.english: to destroy his minbar, to turn over his object of pride,

blocks.transliteration: wa ikhfa'i dinihi wa qat`i dhikrihi
blocks.english: to conceal his religion, and to cut off his mention.

blocks.arabic: يَا مَوَالِيَّ فَلَوْ عَايَنَكُمُ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ وَسِهَامُ ٱلأُمَّةِ مُغْرَقَةٌ فِي أَكْبَادِكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: ya mawaliyya falaw `ayanakum almustafa wa sihamu al-ummati mughraqatun fi akbadikum
blocks.english: O my masters, had the Chosen Prophet seen how the lances of the community (of him) were infixed in your hearts,
how their spears were inserted into your throats,
and how their swords are covered with your blood,

blocks.arabic: يَشْفِي أَبْنَاءُ ٱلْعَوَاهِرِ غَلِيلَ ٱلْفِسْقِ مِنْ وَرَعِكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: yashfi abna'u al`awahiri ghalila alfisqi min wara`ikum
blocks.english: while the sons of whores were quenching their thirst of licentiousness from your godliness,
their thirst of atheism from your faith,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْتُمْ بَيْنَ صَرِيعٍ فِي ٱلْمِحْرَابِ قَدْ فَلَقَ ٱلسَّيْفُ هَامَتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa antum bayna sari`in fi almihrabi qad falaqa alssayfu hamatahu
blocks.english: and one of you was thrown down in the niche while his head is split by sword,

blocks.arabic: وَشَهِيدٍ فَوْقَ ٱلْجَنَازَةِ قَدْ شُكَّتْ أَكْفَانُهُ بِٱلسِّهَامِ
blocks.transliteration: wa shahidin fawqa aljanazati qad shukkat akfanuhu bilssihami
blocks.english: another one was martyred and during his funeral procession arrows heavily stuck his coffin,

blocks.arabic: وَقَتِيلٍ بِٱلْعَرَاءِ قَدْ رُفِعَ فَوْقَ ٱلْقَنَاةِ رَأْسُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa qatilin bil`ara'i qad rufi`a fawqa alqanati ra'suhu
blocks.english: another one was slain and his body was left in the wasteland while his head was raised on a spearhead,

blocks.arabic: وَمُكَبَّلٍ فِي ٱلسِّجْنِ قَدْ رُضَّتْ بِٱلْحَدِيدِ أَعْضَاؤُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa mukabbalin fi alssijni qad ruddat bilhadidi a`da'uhu
blocks.english: another one was enchained in the prison while fetters slept in his limbs,

blocks.arabic: وَمَسْمُومٍ قَدْ قُطِّعَتْ بِجُرَعِ ٱلسُّمِّ أَمْعَاؤُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa masmumin qad qutti`at bijura`i alssummi am`a'uhu
blocks.english: another one was poisoned and poison cut his intestine into parts,

blocks.arabic: وَشَمْلُكُمْ عَبَادِيدُ تُفْنِيهِمُ ٱلْعَبِيدُ وَأَبْنَاءُ ٱلْعَبِيدِ
blocks.transliteration: wa shamlukum `abadidu tufnihim al`abidu wa abna'u al`abidi
blocks.english: and your people are thus scattered; they were terminated by the slaves and the slaves’ sons!

blocks.arabic: فَهَلِ ٱلْمِحَنُ يَا سَادَتِي إِلاَّ ٱلَّتِي لَزِمَتْكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: fahal almihanu ya sadati illa allati lazimatkum
blocks.english: Are ordeals other than those which escorted you?
Are misfortunes other than those which afflicted you?
Are catastrophes other than those which affected you?
Are disasters other than those which distressed you?
Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your souls and your bodies.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: بِأَبِي أَنْتُمْ وَأُمِّي يَا آلَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: bi'abi antum wa ummi ya ala almustafa
blocks.english: May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you, O Household of the Chosen Prophet.

blocks.arabic: إِنَّا لاَ نَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ أَنْ نَطُوفَ حَوْلَ مَشَاهِدِكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: inna la namliku illa an natufa hawla mashahidikum
blocks.english: We have nothing to do more than circumambulating your shrines
so as to console your souls

blocks.arabic: عَلَىٰ هٰذِهِ ٱلْمَصَائِبِ ٱلْعَظِيمَةِ ٱلْحَالَّةِ بِفِنَائِكُمْ
blocks.english: for such grave misfortunes that afflicted you
and unbearable hardships that distressed you;

blocks.arabic: ٱلَّتِي أَثْبَتَتْ فِي قُلُوبِ شِيعَتِكُمُ ٱلْقُرُوحَ
blocks.transliteration: allati athbatat fi qulubi shi`atikumu alquruha
blocks.english: such hardships that fixed wounds in the hearts of your adherents,
installed injuries in their interiors,
and implanted pains in their chests.

blocks.arabic: فَنَحْنُ نُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّا قَدْ شَارَكْنَا أَوْلِيَاءَكُمْ وَأَنْصَارَكُمُ
blocks.transliteration: fanahnu nushhidu allaha anna qad sharakna awliya'akum wa ansarakum
blocks.english: So, we ask Allah to witness for us that we have participated with your allies and supporters

blocks.arabic: ٱلْمُتَقَدِّمِينَ فِي إِرَاقَةِ دِمَاءِ ٱلنَّاكِثِينَ وَٱلْقَاسِطِينَ وَٱلْمَارِقِينَ
blocks.transliteration: almutaqaddimina fi iraqati dima'i alnnakithina walqasitina walmariqina
blocks.english: who passed in time, in the bloodshed of the preachers, the wrongdoers, and the apostates

blocks.arabic: وَقَتَلَةِ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ سَيِّدِ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
blocks.transliteration: wa qatalati abi `abdi allahi sayyidi shababi ahli aljannati `alayhi alssalamu
blocks.english: and of those who slain Abu-`Abdullah the chief of the youth of Paradise, peace be upon him
on that day in Karbala' yet in intentions and hearts

blocks.arabic: وَٱلتَّأَسُّفِ عَلَىٰ فَوْتِ تِلْكَ ٱلْمَوَاقِفِ ٱلَّتِي حَضَرُوٱ لِنُصْرَتِكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: waltta'assufi `ala fawti tilka almawaqifi allati hadaru linusratikum
blocks.english: and in feeling sorry for missing these situations that your allies and supporters witnessed and backed you.
Peace from us be upon you.
Allah’s mercy and blessings, too, be upon you.

blocks.text: You may then stand between the tomb and the kiblah direction and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا ٱلْقُدْرَةِ ٱلَّتِي صَدَرَ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَالَمُ مُكَوَّناً
blocks.transliteration: allahumma ya dha alqudrati allati sadara `anha al`alamu mukawwanan
blocks.english: O Allah! O Lord of the power due to which the world has been brought into existence,

blocks.arabic: مَبْرُوءاً عَلَيْهَا مَفْطُوراً تَحْتَ ظِلِّ ٱلْعَظَمَةِ
blocks.english: created, and originated under the shadow of magnificence.
So, the witnesses of Your making in it have witnessed

blocks.arabic: بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
blocks.transliteration: bi'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
blocks.english: that You are Allah; there is no god save You,
the Maker, Creator, and Originator of it.
You have invented it from no precedent sample,
on account of nothing,
in nothing,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ لِوَحْشَةٍ دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْكَ إِذْ لاَ غَيْرُكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa la liwahshatin dakhalat `alayka idh la ghayruka
blocks.english: not for feeling of loneliness that You may experience because there in none save You,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ حَاجَةٍ بَدَتْ لَكَ فِي تَكْوِينِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la hajatin badat laka fi takwinihi
blocks.english: not for any need that caused You to make it,

blocks.arabic: وَلاَ لٱِسْتِعَانَةٍ مِنْكَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْخَلْقِ بَعْدَهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa la listi`anatin minka `ala alkhalqi ba`dahu
blocks.english: and not for the reason that it may help You create more after it.
Rather, You have formed it so that it would act as proof
(on the fact) that You are too far above being made.
So, the fair-minded cannot deny You
and the sound knowledgeable cannot refute You.
I thus beseech You by the honor of sincere belief in Your Oneness,
the holiness of abidance by Your Book,
and the Household of Your Prophet

blocks.arabic: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ آدَمَ بَدِيعِ فِطْرَتِكَ وَبِكْرِ حُجَّتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: an tusalliya `ala adama badi`i fitratika wa bikri hujjatika
blocks.english: to send blessings upon Adam the example on Your creation, the foremost of Your Argument,

blocks.transliteration: wa lisani qudratika walkhalifati fi basitatika
blocks.english: the spokesman of Your omnipotence, and the representative of You on Your lands
and upon Muhammad the choicest of Your choice,
the evidence on the recognition of You,
the profound, and the trustee on Your most hidden secrets
due to Your grace that You have bestowed upon him out of Your aid;

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ مَنْ بَيْنَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ وَٱلْمُكَرَّمِينَ وَٱلأَوْصِيَاءِ وَٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa `ala man baynahuma min alnnabiyyina walmukarramina wal-awsiya'i walssiddiqina
blocks.english: and (send blessings) upon the Prophets, the honored ones, the Prophets’ successors, and the truthful ones who came between these two;
and to forgive me for the sake of this Imam, my leader.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ بِمَحَلِّ هٰذَا ٱلسَّيِّدِ مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَبِمَنْزِلَتِهِ عِنْدَكَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma bimahalli hadha alssayyidi min ta`atika wa bimanzilatihi `indaka
blocks.english: O Allah, (I beseech You) by the position of this chief as regards his obedience to You and by the rank of him with You,

blocks.arabic: لاَ تُمِتْنِي فُجَاءَةً وَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي تَوْبَةً
blocks.transliteration: la tumitni fuja'atan wa la tahrimni tawbatan
blocks.english: do not grasp my soul suddenly, do not deprive me of repentance,

blocks.arabic: وَٱرْزُقْنِي ٱلْوَرَعَ عَنْ مَحَارِمِكَ دِيناً وَدُنْياً
blocks.transliteration: warzuqni alwara`a `an maharimika dinan wa dunyan
blocks.english: make me stop at the worldly and religious matters that You have deemed forbidden,
make my engagement in the affairs of my Next World distract me from the affairs of this worldly life,

blocks.transliteration: wa waffiqni lima tuhibbu wa tarda
blocks.english: lead me successfully to all that which You please and like,
and keep me away from following my own whims
and being seduced by abortive acts and deceitful expectations.
O Allah, (please do) make all my speech apposite,
all my deeds correct,

blocks.transliteration: walssidqa walwafa'a fi damani wa wa`di
blocks.english: and all my pledges and covenants truthful and honest,

blocks.transliteration: walhifza wal-inasa maqrunayni bi`ahdi wa wa`di
blocks.english: add fulfillment and amiability to my oaths and promises,

blocks.transliteration: walbirra wal-ihsana min sha'ni wa khuluqi
blocks.english: add righteousness and good-doing to my conduct and morals,
grant me comprehensive safety,
make good health encompass and include me,

blocks.transliteration: wa latifa sun`ika wa `awnika masrufan ilayya
blocks.english: make Your kind making and aid direct towards me,

blocks.transliteration: wa husna tawfiqika wa yusrika mawfuran `alayya
blocks.english: make Your granting of success and prosperity flow towards me abundantly,
make me live, O my Lord, with happiness,
grasp my soul as martyr,

blocks.transliteration: wa tahhirni lilmawti wa ma ba`dahu
blocks.english: and purify me for death and what is beyond.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَٱجْعَلِ ٱلصِّحَّةَ وَٱلنُّورَ فِي سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي
blocks.transliteration: allahumma waj`al alssihhata walnnura fi sam`i wa basari
blocks.english: O Allah, add health and light to my hearing and sight,
add straightness and goodness to my courses,

blocks.transliteration: walhuda walbasirata fi dini wa madhhabi
blocks.english: add true guidance and insight to my belief and faith,
make the Scale of deeds always before my eyes,
make remembrance of You and exhortation to be my layer and cover,
make ponderation and learning lessons (from others) to be my entertainment and basis,
make my heart open it doors to conviction,
make it the most certain thing in myself,
make it prevail on my views and determinations,
add true direction to my deeds,
make my submission to Your decisions to be my bed and my support,

blocks.arabic: وَٱلرِّضَا بِقَضَائِكَ وَقَدَرِكَ أَقْصَىٰ عَزْمِي وَنِهَايَتِي
blocks.transliteration: walrrida biqada'ika wa qadarika aqsa `azmi wa nihayati
blocks.english: and make my satisfaction with Your acts to be my utmost purpose, end result,
and the furthest of my reason and intention

blocks.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لاَ أَتَّقِيَ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ بِدِينِي
blocks.transliteration: hatta la attaqiya ahadan min khalqika bidini
blocks.english: so that I shall not fear anybody in matters appertained to my religion,

blocks.transliteration: wa la atluba bihi ghayra akhirati
blocks.english: I shall intend for nothing other than success in my Next Life,

blocks.transliteration: wa la astad`iya minhu itra'i wa madhi
blocks.english: and I shall not hope for praise or approval for it.
And (please do) make my end result to be the best of all,
make my destiny to be the best of all,
make my livelihood to be the most luxurious of all,
lead me to the truest guidance,
make my portion to be the most abundant,

blocks.transliteration: wa azala al-aqsami qismi wa nasibi
blocks.english: make my share to be the largest,

blocks.arabic: وَكُنْ لِي يَا رَبِّ مِنْ كُلِّ سُوءٍ وَلِيّاً
blocks.transliteration: wa kun li ya rabbi min kulli su'in waliyyan
blocks.english: and (please), O my Lord, be my guardian against all evils,

blocks.transliteration: wa ila kulli khayrin dalilan wa qa'idan
blocks.english: my guide and leader to all decencies,

blocks.arabic: وَمِنْ كُلِّ بَاغٍ وَحَسُودٍ ظَهِيراً وَمَانِعاً
blocks.transliteration: wa min kulli baghin wa hasudin zahiran wa mani`an
blocks.english: and my backer and protector against all oppressors and envious ones.
O Allah, to You do I resort, with You do I seek protection,
in You do I trust, from You do I seek success,
from You do I derive might and power,
in Your hands are my life and death,

blocks.transliteration: wa fi qabdatika sukuni wa harakati
blocks.english: under Your control are all my stillness and motions,

blocks.transliteration: wa inna bi`urwatika alwuthqa istimsaki wa wuslati
blocks.english: by Your Firmest Handle do I abide, to it do I connect,

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَيْكَ فِي ٱلأُمُورِ كُلِّهَا ٱعْتِمَادِي وَتَوَكُّلِي
blocks.transliteration: wa `alayka fi al-umuri kulliha i`timadi wa tawakkuli
blocks.english: on You do I rely and depend in all of my affairs,

blocks.arabic: وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ وَمَسِّ سَقَرَ نَجَاتِي وَخَلاَصِي
blocks.transliteration: wa min `adhabi jahannama wa massi saqara najati wa khalasi
blocks.english: and from You do I seek salvation and redemption against the chastisement of Hell and the touch of Hellfire.

blocks.arabic: وَفِي دَارِ أَمْنِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ مَثْوَايَ وَمُنْقَلَبِي
blocks.transliteration: wa fi dari amnika wa karamatika mathwaya wa munqalabi
blocks.english: So (please), decide my final house to be in the abode of Your security and honor

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَىٰ أَيْدِي سَادَتِي وَمَوَالِيَّ آلِ ٱلْمُصْطَفَىٰ فَوْزِي وَفَرَجِي
blocks.transliteration: wa `ala aydi sadati wa mawaliyya ali almustafa fawzi wa faraji
blocks.english: and my success and relief to be at the hands of my masters and chiefs the Household of the Chosen Prophet.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
forgive the believing men and women and Muslim men and women,

blocks.transliteration: waghfir li wa liwalidayya wa ma walada
blocks.english: forgive my parents, their descendants,
my family members, my neighbors,

blocks.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ مَنْ قَلَّدَنِي يَداً مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: wa likulli man qalladani yadan min almu'minina walmu'minati
blocks.english: and all the believing men and women for whom I concern.
Verily, You are the Lord of immense favor.

blocks.transliteration: walssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.text:
After completion of ziarat, say two rakat prayers and present it as your gift to Imam(ajtfs) and seek intercession of Imam to supplicate to God to grant your wishes. & recite this dua

Dua Aliya Mazameen

. Refrences

1.Shaykh Abbas al-Qommi, Mafatih al-Jinan, p. 657.

2. Shaykh al-Sadouq, Ayun Akhbar al-Rida, vol. 1, p. 305.

3. Shaykh al-Kulayni, al-Kafi, vol. 8, p. 146

This dua can be recited after visiting all the Holy Imams (peace be upon them). Sayyid Ibn Tawus, in his book of Misbah al-Zair, has mentioned this to be said directly after Ziyarah Aimmatul Momineen in particular.

blocks.english: O Allah, I am visiting this Imam
confessing his Imamate
and believing in the obligation of the obedience to him;
therefore, I have betaken myself to his shrine in spite of all of my sins, defects,
the perils of my wrongdoings,
my numerous misdeeds and faults,
and whatsoever You know about me;
taking shelter in Your amnesty,
seeking refuge of Your forbearance,
hoping for Your mercy,
resorting to Your asylum,
seeking the protection of Your compassion,

seeking the intercession of Your vicegerent and the son (If this supplication is said at the holy shrine of Imam `Ali (`a), the word ‘wabni (and the son)’ must be changed into ‘wa abi (and the father)’.) of Your vicegerent,
Your choicest servant and the son of Your choicest servants,
Your trustee and the son of Your trustees,
and Your representative and the son of Your representatives,

blocks.arabic: الَّذِينَ جَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيلَةَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَ رِضْوَانِكَ
blocks.transliteration: alladhina ja`altahum alwasilata ila rahmatika wa ridwanika
blocks.english: whom You have made the means to approach Your mercy and pleasure

blocks.arabic: وَ الذَّرِيعَةَ إِلَى رَأْفَتِكَ وَ غُفْرَانِكَ‏
blocks.english: and the channels to Your compassion and forgiveness.
O Allah, my first need from You

blocks.arabic: أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي عَلَى كَثْرَتِهَا
blocks.transliteration: an taghfira li ma salafa min dhunubi `ala kathratiha
blocks.english: is that I implore You to forgive all of my previous sins although they are numerous,

blocks.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَعْصِمَنِي فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمْرِي
blocks.transliteration: wa an ta`simani fima baqiya min `umri
blocks.english: to protect me (against sinning) in my coming lifetime,
to purify my religion from whatsoever stains,
disgraces, or degrades it,

blocks.arabic: وَ تَحْمِيَهُ مِنَ الرَّيْبِ وَ الشَّكِّ
blocks.english: to save it from suspect, doubt,
corruption, and blasphemy,
to make me stand firm on the obedience to You,
to Your Messenger,
and to his Progeny the pure and happy,
may Your blessings be upon them

blocks.arabic: وَ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ سَلاَمُكَ وَ بَرَكَاتُكَ‏
blocks.transliteration: wa rahmatuka wa salamuka wa barakatuka
blocks.english: as well as Your mercy, peace, and favors,

blocks.arabic: وَ تُحْيِيَنِي مَا أَحْيَيْتَنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِهِمْ
blocks.english: to make me live as long as You grant me life on the obedience to them,

blocks.arabic: وَ تُمِيتَنِي إِذَا أَمَتَّنِي عَلَى طَاعَتِهِمْ‏
blocks.english: to make me die, when You decide so, on the obedience to them,

blocks.arabic: وَ أَنْ لاَ تَمْحُوَ مِنْ قَلْبِي مَوَدَّتَهُمْ وَ مَحَبَّتَهُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa an la tamhuwa min qalbi mawaddatahum wa mahabbatahum
blocks.english: and not to erase from my heart my love and affection for them,
my aversion to their enemies,
my companionship of their adherents, and my acting piously towards them.

blocks.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنِّي
blocks.transliteration: wa as'aluka ya rabbi an taqbala dhalika minni
blocks.english: I also beseech You, O my Lord, to accept all that from me,
to endear my worshipping You to myself,
to endue me with perseverance in worship,
to make me active in it,

blocks.arabic: وَ تُبَغِّضَ إِلَيَّ مَعَاصِيَكَ وَ مَحَارِمَكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa tubaghghida ilayya ma`asiyaka wa maharimaka
blocks.english: to make me loathe acts of disobedience to You and acts that You deemed forbidden,
to take me away from these acts,
to save me against negligence of my prayers,
belittling them,
and slackening in their performance,

blocks.arabic: وَ تُوَفِّقَنِي لِتَأْدِيَتِهَا كَمَا فَرَضْتَ‏ وَ أَمَرْتَ بِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa tuwaffiqani lita'diyatiha kama faradta wa amarta bihi
blocks.english: to lead me to perform them as perfect as You have made incumbent upon me and as You have commanded
according to the traditions of Your Messenger,
may Your blessings be upon him and his Household
as well as Your mercy and favors,
with submission and reverence,
to expand my breast for defraying the poor-rate,
giving alms,
giving charity,

blocks.arabic: وَ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَى شِيعَةِ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.english: and doing favors to the adherents of the Household of Muhammad,
peace be upon them, and for consoling them.

blocks.arabic: وَ لاَ تَتَوَفَّانِي إِلاَّ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي حِجَّ بَيْتِكَ الْحَرَامِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la tatawaffani illa ba`da an tarzuqani hajja baytika alharami
blocks.english: Do not take me up (i.e. cause me to die) before You bestow upon me with the favor of going on pilgrimage to Your Sacred House
and to the tomb of Your Prophet
and the tombs of the Imams, peace be upon them.

blocks.arabic: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا رَبِّ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً تَرْضَاهَا
blocks.transliteration: wa as'aluka ya rabbi tawbatan nasuhan tardaha
blocks.english: I also beseech You, O Lord, to grant me a sincere repentance that You accept,
an intention that You praise,
and righteous deed that You admit,

blocks.arabic: وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَ تَرْحَمَنِي إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي
blocks.transliteration: wa an taghfira li wa tarhamani idha tawaffaytani
blocks.english: to forgive me and have mercy upon me when You take me up,
to make easy for me the agonies of death,

blocks.arabic: وَ تَحْشُرَنِي فِي زُمْرَةِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa tahshurani fi zumrati muhammadin wa alihi
blocks.english: to include me with the group of Muhammad and his Household,
peace of Allah be upon him and them,
to allow me to enter Paradise out of Your mercy,

blocks.arabic: وَ تَجْعَلَ دَمْعِي غَزِيراً فِي طَاعَتِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa taj`ala dam`i ghaziran fi ta`atika
blocks.english: to make me shed heavy tears as obeisance to You,

blocks.arabic: وَ عَبْرَتِي جَارِيَةً فِيمَا يُقَرِّبُنِي مِنْكَ
blocks.english: to make my tears always run down in acts that draw me near You,
to make my heart sympathetic towards Your intimate servants,
to save me in this worldly life
from handicaps, epidemics,
incurable diseases,
chronic illnesses,

blocks.arabic: وَ جَمِيعِ أَنْوَاعِ الْبَلاَءِ وَ الْحَوَادِثِ
blocks.english: and all sorts of misfortunes and catastrophes.
[I also beseech You to] cause my heart to turn away from the forbidden (acts and things),
make me hate acts of disobedience to You,
make me love the legally gotten sustenance
open its doors before me,

blocks.arabic: وَ تُثَبِّتَ نِيَّتِي وَ فِعْلِي عَلَيْهِ
blocks.english: make firm my intention and my deeds on it,
extend my lifetime,
and close the doors of adversaries before me.

blocks.arabic: وَ لاَ تَسْلُبَنِي مَا مَنَنْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ
blocks.transliteration: wa la taslubani ma mananta bihi `alayya
blocks.english: (Please) do not deprive me of whatsoever You have favored upon me,

blocks.arabic: وَ لاَ تَسْتَرِدَّ شَيْئًا مِمَّا أَحْسَنْتَ بِهِ إِلَيَ‏
blocks.transliteration: wa la tastaridda shay'an mimma ahsanta bihi ilayya
blocks.english: do not take back from me the graces that You have granted me,

blocks.arabic: وَ لاَ تَنْزِعَ مِنِّي النِّعَمَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ بِهَا عَلَيَّ
blocks.transliteration: wa la tanzi` minniya alnni`ama allati an`amta biha `alayya
blocks.english: do not strip me of the elegances that You have conferred upon me;
[rather, please] increase that which You have authorized me to possess,
expand it many folds for me,
and provide me with fortune that is very much,
spacious, agreeable,
joyful, growing, and satisfactory,
and with dignity that is everlasting and sufficient,
and with prestige that is outgoing and overwhelming,
and with bounty that is flowing and broad.

blocks.arabic: وَ تُغْنِيَنِي بِذَلِكَ عَنِ الْمَطَالِبِ الْمُنَكَّدَةِ
blocks.english: Through all that, (please) make me dispense with the humiliating appeals
and unreachable sources,
save me from them with good health

blocks.arabic: فِي دِينِي وَ نَفْسِي وَ وَلَدِي
blocks.transliteration: fi dini wa nafsi wa waladi
blocks.english: as regards my religion, self, sons,
and whatsoever You have given and granted me,
preserve for me my properties
and whatsoever You have put under my disposal,
watch me against the hands of the tyrants,
take me back to my homeland (safely),

blocks.arabic: وَ تُبَلِّغَنِي نِهَايَةَ أَمَلِي فِي دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي
blocks.transliteration: wa tuballighani nihayata amali fi dunyaya wa akhirati
blocks.english: confer upon me the utmost of my hope in my worldly life and the Hereafter,

blocks.arabic: وَ تَجْعَلَ عَاقِبَةَ أَمْرِي مَحْمُودَةً حَسَنَةً سَلِيمَةً
blocks.transliteration: wa taj`ala `aqibata amri mahmudatan hasanatan salimatan
blocks.english: make the consequence of my conducts praiseworthy, good, and sound,
make me broadminded,
well-off,
and well-mannered,
[and take me] away from miserliness, stinginess.
hypocrisy, fabrication,
slander, and perjury.

blocks.arabic: وَ تُرْسِخَ فِي قَلْبِي مَحَبَّةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ شِيعَتِهِمْ‏
blocks.transliteration: wa tursikha fi qalbi mahabbata muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa shi`atihim
blocks.english: [Please] make firm in my heart the love for Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and their adherents (Shi`ah).

blocks.arabic: وَ تَحْرُسَنِي يَا رَبِّ فِي نَفْسِي وَ أَهْلِي
blocks.transliteration: wa tahrusani ya rabbi fi nafsi wa ahli
blocks.english: O Lord, guard me, my family,
my properties, my sons,
those who are under my custody, my brothers,
those whom I love, and my offspring
in the name of Your mercy and Magnanimity.
O Allah, these are my needs from You.

blocks.arabic: وَ قَدِ اسْتَكْثَرْتُهَا لِلُؤْمِي وَ شُحِّي
blocks.transliteration: wa qad istakthartuha lilu'mi wa shuhhi
blocks.english: Out of my meanness and avarice, I have considered these needs great,
while in Your view the are insignificantly small
and they are easy and effortless for You.

blocks.arabic: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجَاهِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: fa'as'aluka bijahi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: I thus beseech You in the name of the standing of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
peace be upon him and them, in Your view,
in the name of Your duty towards You,
in the name of what You have made incumbent upon Yourself towards them,
in the name of Your other Prophets and Messengers,
in the name of Your choicest ones and intimate servants
whom You have selected over others for worshipping You,
and in the name of Your Grand, Substantial Name,
(I beseech You by all these) to grant me all of my requests,
to relieve me through settling them for me,

blocks.arabic: وَ لَمْ تُخَيِّبْ أَمَلِي وَ رَجَائِي‏
blocks.transliteration: wa lam tukhayyib amali wa raja'i
blocks.english: and not to disappoint nor let me down.

blocks.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَ شَفِّعْ صَاحِبَ هَذَا الْقَبْرِ فِيَ‏
blocks.transliteration: allahumma wa shaffi` sahiba hadha alqabri fiyya
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) accept the one in this tomb as my interceder before You.

blocks.arabic: يَا سَيِّدِي يَا وَلِيَّ اللَّهِ يَا أَمِينَ اللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: ya sayyidi ya waliyya allahi ya amina allahi
blocks.english: O my Master! O Allah’s vicegerent! O Allah’s trustee!

blocks.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَشْفَعَ لِي إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
blocks.transliteration: as'aluka an tashfa`a li ila allahi `azza wa jalla
blocks.english: I beseech you to intercede for me before Allah the Almighty and All-majestic
so that He may approve of and grant me all of my requests
in the name of Your Immaculate fathers
and in the name of Your well-selected sons.

blocks.arabic: فَإِنَّ لَكَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُهُ
blocks.english: Verily, you enjoy in the view of Allah, sacred be His Names,
an honorable standing,
a lofty rank,
and a spacious regard.

blocks.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَوْ عَرَفْتُ مَنْ هُوَ أَوْجَهُ عِنْدَكَ
blocks.english: O Allah, had I known a person more acceptable in Your view
than this Imam

blocks.arabic: وَ مِنْ آبَائِهِ وَ أَبْنَائِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: wa min aba'ihi wa abna'ihi alttahirina
blocks.english: and his immaculate fathers and sons,
peace and blessings be upon them,
I would have chosen them to be my interceders (before You)

blocks.arabic: وَ قَدَّمْتُهُمْ أَمَامَ حَاجَتِي وَ طَلِبَاتِي هَذِهِ‏
blocks.transliteration: wa qaddamtuhum amama hajati wa talibati hadhihi
blocks.english: and I would have introduced them as means by whom I would put before You my needs and requests.
Therefore, (please) hear from me,
respond to me,

blocks.arabic: وَ افْعَلْ بِي مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ
blocks.english: and do to me that which You alone are worthy to do.
O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

blocks.arabic: االلَّهُمَّ وَ مَا قَصُرَتْ عَنْهُ مَسْأَلَتِي
blocks.english: O Allah, as regards the needs that my requests have not included,
the things that I am too powerless to do,
and the things that I am not too clever to mention,

blocks.arabic: مِنْ صَالِحِ دِينِي و وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي‏
blocks.transliteration: min salihi dini wa dunyaya wa akhirati
blocks.english: among the things that prosper my religion, worldly life, and next life;
(please) confer upon me with these,
protect me, guard me,

blocks.arabic: وَ هَبْ لِي وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
blocks.english: bestow upon me (with Your favors), and forgive me.

blocks.arabic: وَ مَنْ أَرَادَنِي بِسُوءٍ أَوْ مَكْرُوهٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa man aradani bisu'in aw makruhin
blocks.english: As for any one who intends evil or wickedness to me,
such as a rebellious devil,
a tyrant ruler,
a dissident miscreant,
a rival in a worldly affair,
one who envies me for a grace,
an unjust individual, or a despot;
then (please) make their hands too short to catch me,
take away their plots against me,
preoccupy them against me with their own affairs,
save me from their evils
and the evils of their followers and devils,

blocks.arabic: وَ أَجِرْنِي مِنْ كُلِّ مَا يَضُرُّنِي وَ يُجْحِفُ بِي
blocks.transliteration: wa ajirni min kulli ma yadurruni wa yujhifu bi
blocks.english: stand by me against whatsoever may harm and do injustice to me,
and (please) grant me the entire goodness

blocks.arabic: مِمَّا أَعْلَمُ وَ مِمَّا لاَ أَعْلَمُ‏
blocks.transliteration: mimma a`lamu wa mimma la a`lamu
blocks.english: whether I know or I do not.

blocks.arabic: االلَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
and forgive me, my parents,
my brothers, my sisters,
my (paternal) uncles, my (paternal) aunts,
my (maternal) uncles, my (maternal) aunts,
my forefathers, my foremothers,
their descendants, their offspring,
my spouse(s), my offspring,
my relatives, my friends,
my neighbors, my brothers-in-faith
from the people of the east and the west (of the earth),
all those whom I love
among the believing men and women,
be they alive or dead,
all those who have ever taught me an item of decency,
and those who have received from me an item of knowledge.
O Allah, make all these have a share in my best supplications to You

blocks.arabic: وَ زِيَارَتِي لِمَشْهَدِ حُجَّتِكَ وَ وَلِيِّكَ‏
blocks.transliteration: wa ziyarati limashhadi hujjatika wa waliyyika
blocks.english: and in my (ritual) pilgrimages to the shrine of Your Argument and Your vicegerent;
make me have a share in the best of their supplications,
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.
Convey their greetings to Your vicegerent.

blocks.arabic: وَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah's mercy and blessings be upon you.
O my master, O my leader; O…(You should here mention the name of the Imam you are visiting.)
may Allah bless you,
your soul, and your body;
you are my means to approach Allah
and my way towards Him;

blocks.arabic: وَ لِي حَقُّ مُوَالاَتِي وَ تَأْمِيلِي‏
blocks.transliteration: wa li haqqu muwalati wa ta'mili
blocks.english: and I enjoy the right of my loyalty to you and the right of my putting my entire hope in you;

blocks.arabic: فَكُنْ شَفِيعِي إِلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ
blocks.transliteration: fakun shafi`i ila allahi `azza wa jalla
blocks.english: therefore, be my interceder before Allah the Almighty and All-majestic
so that He shall regard my story (that I have just told)

blocks.arabic: وَ صَرْفِي عَنْ مَوْقِفِي هَذَا بِالنُّجْحِ
blocks.english: and so that He shall decide success to be the result of all of my requests in this situation of mine

blocks.arabic: بِمَا سَأَلْتُهُ كُلِّهِ بِرَحْمَتِهِ وَ قُدْرَتِهِ‏
blocks.transliteration: bima sa'altuhu kullihi birahmatihi wa qudratihi
blocks.english: that I have besought from Him, out of His mercy and omnipotence.
O Allah, (please) bestow upon me a perfect intellectuality,
a sagacious reason,
an everlasting might,
a pure heart,
a very much deed,
and excellent manners;
decide all these to be for my good,
but do not make them stand against me;
in the name of Your mercy, O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت ائمہ المؤمنین کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
